descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S04 「现成的 spec：养老院的任务审查没有 email 按钮、没有 mailto」 Existing spec: Nursing Home task review has no email button and no mailto

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given One resident on Today's Visits with an open task (unit B) and one resident not on Today's Visits with an open task

When Open /snf/tasks

Then Heading 'Pending Tasks'; no button named Email and no mailto link; the today resident's task and 'Unit B' are shown

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions, evidence for U9 in Nursing Home only. spec-matrix.mjs records the whole test, and the same test asserts that the resident not on Today's Visits is hidden, the opposite of what S12 expects under AC 2 / Q1. So a failure is triaged first: if the failing expectation is the hidden not-today resident ('Should not appear'), it is reported under Q1 / S12, not U9 …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
